title: Robert O'Neal Multicultural Arts Center

services.name: Habari Gani Exhibition
services.desc: Celebrating Black visual and performing women artists, their strengths, diversity, and the power they have to unify through their journeys, FIRE: Herstory opened in the Spring of 2021 to universal praise. Fire is a metaphor for fierce, glowing, passion, and the external flame of truth. This experience explored black women through the lens of love, hope, survival empowerment, beauty, sisterhood, and self-worth. Rebecca Shakespeare Armstrong Linda M. Chapman Monique Brent Dunson Janice Frierson Grace E. Haggard Ryan Nichole Leary Cynthia Lockhart Adoria L. Maxberry Ricci Michaels Velma J. Morris Jean Polk Annie Ruth Toilynn O'Neal Turner Jane Henri Williams Joyce Phillips Young Candice Handy
